instruction.text: Complete the sentence with the missing word.

atoms.a: Flash floods in the desert cause beautiful patterns of erosion in narrow canyons.
atoms.b: Flash floods in the desert cause beautiful patterns of ((erosion)) in narrow canyons.

atoms.a: Do you know what to do if you ever encounter a polar bear?
atoms.b: Do you know what to do if you ever ((encounter)) a polar bear?

atoms.a: A parent’s involvement in their child’s education is encouraged by many teachers.
atoms.b: A parent’s ((involvement)) in their child’s education is encouraged by many teachers.

atoms.a: A good introduction is important to make an impression on others, but remember that first impressions aren’t everything.
atoms.b: A good ((introduction)) is important to make an impression on others, but remember that first impressions aren’t everything.

atoms.a: Do these glasses make me look more intelligent?
atoms.b: Do these glasses make me look more ((intelligent))?
